column2: Wild leeks grow about forty paces off, a little east of north. The yellow mountain flower is down by the water, about fifty paces east, a little south.
I am a hatchling of Flaa Heet's village. I run errands to the barrels, and I watch the path to the dock for strangers.
Flaa Heet leads our village. Three villagers live here with him, and I am the child. Two of the villagers sell from stalls.
